readme.markdown:
# Thisispaper MCP

[![smithery badge](https://smithery.ai/badge/thisispaper/thisispaper)](https://smithery.ai/server/thisispaper/thisispaper)

Thisispaper is an independent art, architecture and design publication. Every project in the archive was curated by human editors since 2011.

Search 2,500+ curated projects: search, visual similarity, and full project metadata with material, light, mood and composition tags written during curation. Free tier, no signup to try.

Contact: studio@thisispaper.com

- **Endpoint (Streamable HTTP, stateless):** `https://www.thisispaper.com/intelligence/api/mcp`
- **Docs:** [thisispaper.com/intelligence/api-docs](https://www.thisispaper.com/intelligence/api-docs)
- **Auth:** optional. Anonymous requests work out of the box (results capped at 5). A free self-serve key (200 calls/month) unlocks full results via `Authorization: Bearer tip_live_...`

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `search` | ChatGPT-connector search: results with id, title, url |
| `fetch` | ChatGPT-connector fetch: one project, full record, embeds the real thumbnail image |
| `search_projects` | Ranked search across the archive: name, studio, city, year, category, intro, thumbnail, citation URL, provenance |
| `similar_projects` | Visually + semantically similar projects for a slug (precomputed SigLIP neighbours) |
| `get_project` | Full metadata for one project: description, design language, details, taste dimensions |
| `search_by_taste` | Search by curation-time taste tags: material, light, color, mood, composition, subject |
| `browse` | Newest projects, optionally by category (architecture, interiors, design, photography, art) |
| `discover` | One project at random: editorial serendipity as a tool |
| `get_api_key` | Mints a free API key (200 calls/month) for an email address |

Every project-shaped response carries `provenance` (curated by, selection date, in archive since) and a permanent `citation_url`.

## Install

### Cursor

[Add to Cursor](https://cursor.com/en/install-mcp?name=thisispaper&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL3d3dy50aGlzaXNwYXBlci5jb20vaW50ZWxsaWdlbmNlL2FwaS9tY3AifQ%3D%3D)

Or add to `.cursor/mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "thisispaper": {
      "url": "https://www.thisispaper.com/intelligence/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

### Gemini CLI

```bash
gemini extensions install https://github.com/zaxarovcom/thisispaper-mcp
```

### Claude Code

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http thisispaper https://www.thisispaper.com/intelligence/api/mcp
```

### Claude.ai (custom connector)

Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → URL: `https://www.thisispaper.com/intelligence/api/mcp`

### Any MCP client (generic)

Transport: Streamable HTTP. URL: `https://www.thisispaper.com/intelligence/api/mcp`. No OAuth. Optional header: `Authorization: Bearer tip_live_...`

## Getting a free key

Ask the agent to call `get_api_key` with your email, or use the [API docs page](https://www.thisispaper.com/intelligence/api-docs). 200 calls/month, no card.

## Try it

```
"Find concrete chapels in the Thisispaper archive"
"Show me projects similar to audeum-kengo-kuma"
"What materials define Japanese teahouse projects?"
"Find projects with rammed earth and dusk light"
```

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search 2,500+ hand-curated architecture, design, photography and art projects from Thisispaper. Returns a list of results with id, title and url.

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the full record for one Thisispaper project by id (the id returned by search). Returns title, text and the public url.

toolsPreview.name: search_projects
toolsPreview.description: Search 2,500+ hand-curated architecture, design, photography and art projects from Thisispaper. Returns ranked summaries (name, studio, city, year, category, intro, thumbnail, url, citation_url, provenance). Without an API key, results are capped at 5; pass Authorization: Bearer tip_live_... for full results.

toolsPreview.name: similar_projects
toolsPreview.description: Nearest projects to a given slug by visual + semantic similarity (precomputed SigLIP neighbours). Use the slug from search_projects results.

toolsPreview.name: get_project
toolsPreview.description: Full metadata for one project: machine-written description, design language, details and dimensions, plus the public URL.

toolsPreview.name: search_by_taste
toolsPreview.description: Search by taste metadata: material, light, color, mood, composition, subject. Unique to Thisispaper: these tags were written during human curation. Provide at least one dimension; results are ranked by how many dimensions match, then by recency.

toolsPreview.name: browse
toolsPreview.description: Newest projects in the archive first, optionally filtered by category: architecture, interiors, design, photography or art.

toolsPreview.name: discover
toolsPreview.description: One project chosen at random from the archive. Editorial serendipity: the way a reader opens a magazine to an unplanned spread.

toolsPreview.name: list_guides
toolsPreview.description: Every hand-curated Thisispaper guide and edition. Guides are places: Tokyo, Kyoto, Lisbon, Copenhagen. Editions are themes: Black Matter (black as a way of handling light), Jutaku (Japanese houses on narrow plots), Icons, Off-the-Grid, Monographs on single architects. Returns each one's title, type, one-line description, cover image and public URL. Filter by city or by type. The full guides and editions are reserved for Thisispaper+ members.

toolsPreview.name: get_api_key
toolsPreview.description: Mint a FREE Thisispaper Intelligence API key (200 calls/month) for an email address. The key is shown once; use it as Authorization: Bearer tip_live_... on this MCP endpoint and on the REST API. Max 3 keys per email.
